spans.label: Imported plonky2 recursion and cyclic helpers
spans.note: `use` lines pull in plonky2 builder/proof APIs, the Poseidon and keccak gadgets and the typed limb traits. The model treats all of them as opaque callbacks or premises; no lowering is proved.

spans.label: BlockHashChainCircuitError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the prove and verify failure kinds are modeled by the shared Fault type.

spans.label: Circuit handle, proof target and impl bounds
spans.note: CircuitData and ProofWithPublicInputsTarget are opaque plonky2 objects; only the public-input list they carry is modeled.

spans.label: BlockHashChainCircuit::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the wrapper verifies the block-step proof against baked-in verifier data and re-registers the parsed 2*48 + vd prefix verbatim. The build-time common-data assertion is checked before the build-success assertion. Recursive verification itself is an opaque predicate.

spans.label: generate_cd template circuit construction
spans.note: simple_recursion_circuit_data, add_virtual_proof_with_pis, verify_proof and add_noop_gates shape the CommonCircuitData; none of that is modeled.

spans.label: generate_cd public-input count override
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; num_public_inputs is overwritten with BLOCK_CHAIN_PUBLIC_INPUTS_LEN + vd_vec_len(config).

spans.label: BlockHashChainCircuit::prove
spans.note: Witness assignment and plonky2 proving for this wrapper are not modeled.

spans.label: BlockHashChainCircuit::verify
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data runs BEFORE data.verify, and both must succeed. Whether either check is cryptographically sound is a boundary.

boundaries.name: recursive_verification
boundaries.obligation: add_proof_target_and_verify and data.verify are opaque predicates. Nothing derives soundness, completeness or knowledge-extraction from them.

boundaries.name: common_data_shape
boundaries.obligation: The equality of the built CommonCircuitData with the generated template (and therefore the cyclic self-compatibility of this wrapper) is asserted at build time in Rust; the model records the check order only.

boundaries.name: cyclic_verifier_data
boundaries.obligation: check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data is modeled as a boolean gate in the native verify path; its Merkle-cap/digest semantics are not modeled.

boundaries.name: pass_through_wrapper
boundaries.obligation: The wrapper adds no constraint of its own on the re-exported verifier data; the binding to this circuit's own key comes from the native cyclic check and from ValidityCircuit's add_proof_target_and_verify_cyclic. That the combination is sufficient is not proved here.
